 Farhana Haque Appointed as Country Lead & Executive Director – Platform Business at Ingram Micro
 October 27, 2026 
 0 
 99 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp Linkedin 
 Ingram Micro India has appointed Farhana Haque as Country Lead & Executive Director – Platform Business , where she will drive the next phase of the company’s platform business growth and partner ecosystem development.
 In her new leadership role, Farhana will focus on expanding the small and medium-sized business (SMB) segment, accelerating platform adoption, and strengthening partner and customer engagement. Her mandate also includes simplifying partner interactions and advancing a more connected, digitally enabled experience across the ecosystem.
 Farhana brings extensive experience in enterprise transformation, AI strategy, commercial growth and technology-led business expansion. In her most recent role as Senior Director, she led transformation initiatives and commercial development across strategic services, cloud solutions and modern workplace offerings.
 Earlier, she headed Vodafone’s Internet of Things business, building strategic partnerships and scaling operations across India and Asia-Pacific. At IBM, she served as General Manager for the Distribution Sector, leading initiatives spanning business analytics, operational optimisation and organisational transformation.
 Her appointment reflects Ingram Micro India’s continued focus on strengthening its platform-led model and enabling technology partners to navigate an increasingly complex digital landscape through improved integration, automation and access to technology solutions.
